visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a finished product showcase featuring two glossy, golden-brown scallion braided breads on a grey plate. A person's hand is visible on the left side, positioned near a white plant pot with green leaves by a bright window. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a bread machine bucket where dough is being mixed and kneaded into a smooth ball. (3) On a white marble countertop, hands use a red scraper to divide the dough, weigh it on a digital scale, and roll it into nine separate balls. (4) The dough balls are then flattened with a rolling pin and rolled into long, thin cylindrical shapes. (5) The hands demonstrate a braiding technique, crossing three strips of dough together to form a thick, decorative loaf. (6) A transition shows scallions being chopped rapidly on a dark brown Epicurean cutting board, then transferred to a glass measuring cup to be mixed with oil and salt. (7) The proofed braided dough on a baking tray is brushed with a yellow egg wash and topped with the prepared scallion mixture. (8) The tray is placed into a white HEALSIO water oven. (9) The final phase shows the bread being squeezed to show its soft texture and sliced to reveal a fluffy white interior crumb.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 蔥花辮子麵包. (2) [Subtitle]: 打麵糰 + 一次發酵. (3) [Subtitle]: 分割9等份滾圓 休息10分鐘. (4) [Subtitle]: 擀平捲起來. (5) [Subtitle]: 休息5分鐘 再搓長. (6) [Subtitle]: 美美辮子的秘訣 從中間開始綁. (7) [Subtitle]: 用水波爐40度 發酵40-50分鐘. (8) [Variety]: 秘訣 蔥花不能切太細. (9) [Subtitle]: 玄米油 鹽巴. (10) [Subtitle]: 發酵好了. (11) [Subtitle]: 塗上蛋液. (12) [Subtitle]: 放上蔥花 建議放更多. (13) [Subtitle]: 210度 11分鐘 前五分鐘 一顆蒸汽. (14) [Subtitle]: 蔥花不夠的補救方法. (15) [Subtitle]: 先把燒乾的拿起來 再補上更多蔥花 回烤箱210度 1.5分鐘. (16) [Subtitle]: 這樣就可以了. (17) [Subtitle]: 放到隔天. (18) [Variety]: 超軟 Q. (19) [Variety]: 好美的剖面. (20) [Slogan]: 食譜 還有更多小秘訣 請看留言喔.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A clean, modern kitchen with marble countertops, a HEALSIO water oven, an Epicurean cutting board, and various glass kitchenware. A window provides natural light, and a small green plant in a white pot is used for aesthetic decoration.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with bright, rhythmic acoustic guitar strumming in a major key, accompanied by a light, percussive shaker. (2) A distinctive mechanical thumping sound from the bread machine is layered over the music. (3) Crisp, high-frequency chopping sounds occur rapidly as the scallions are cut, synchronized with the visual edits. (4) A digital chime and a mechanical click mark the setting and opening of the oven. (5) There is a soft thud and scraping sound as the baking tray is moved. (6) A subtle crinkling sound of a plastic lid and a soft, airy tearing sound are audible when the bread is squeezed and sliced near the end. The upbeat guitar music remains the constant, driving force throughout the track.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide a comprehensive step-by-step guide for baking scallion braided bread, highlighting specific techniques for braiding and post-bake improvements while showcasing the product's soft texture to entice the viewer to try the recipe.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Frequent prominent display of the HEALSIO water oven and Epicurean cutting board during the cooking process.
